title: The two perspectives of the world

cues.en: Instructor: This section of the course is all about signal detection theory and the different information metrics that we can derive from signal detection theory.
cues.zh: 講師：這個單元專談訊號偵測理論，以及能從中推導的資訊指標。

cues.en: And I'm gonna start this section here by talking about the two perspectives of the world, two different ways of seeing the world.
cues.zh: 先談世界的兩個觀點、兩種看世界的方式。

cues.en: And this is going to be kind of the leading factor that allows us to derive everything else in signal detection theory.
cues.zh: 這會是推導其他內容的主要出發點。

cues.en: And I'm gonna start this section by giving an talking about an imaginary experiment.
cues.zh: 先舉想像的實驗。

cues.en: So let's imagine we're doing a psychophysics experiment, so we're interested in how well people can perceive different things in the world.
cues.zh: 假設做心理物理實驗，研究人對世界不同事物的知覺能力。

cues.en: So, and in particular we're gonna focus on brief flashes of light.
cues.zh: 特別聚焦短暫閃光。

cues.en: So here's what we do, we get our friendly, cute little research participant, and she comes into the research laboratory and we sit her down at a chair in front of a computer
cues.zh: 找親切可愛的研究參與者，到實驗室坐在電腦前，

cues.en: and we tell her every couple of seconds we're going to flash something on the computer screen, possibly it's either gonna be a light on the computer
cues.zh: 告訴她，每幾秒可能在螢幕閃東西，可能是光，

cues.en: screen, maybe it's just, you know, two pixels on the computer screen that light up, or we're not gonna show you anything.
cues.zh: 也許只讓兩個像素亮起，或者完全不呈現。

cues.en: Now you might be looking at your computer screen right now and saying, well, this is a stupid experiment.
cues.zh: 你可能看著螢幕想，實驗好蠢。

cues.en: Obviously you see stuff, but it turns out even if you flash a light, if the the light is dim and if it's flashed really quickly, like just a couple
cues.zh: 顯然看得到，但光若很暗、閃得很快，只有幾

cues.en: of milliseconds, it can actually be really difficult for people to know whether you flash that light.
cues.zh: 毫秒，實際上很難知道是否閃過。

cues.en: So we flash a light, it's either, so it's very dim and it's very small and it's very fast.
cues.zh: 呈現很暗、很小、很快的閃光。

cues.en: So she might not actually see that we've flashed this light.
cues.zh: 她可能真的沒看到。

cues.en: And there are other times that we actually don't flash the light at all.
cues.zh: 其他時候，根本不閃光。

cues.en: So, and then we want to see does she realize that we didn't flash the light or is maybe she's a little bit unsure and she kind of thought there could have been a light flash
cues.zh: 想知道她是否知道沒閃，或有點不確定，以為可能閃過，

cues.en: because yeah, sometimes the real light flashes dim.
cues.zh: 因為真正閃光有時很暗。

cues.en: Anyway, this is the experiment.
cues.zh: 這就是實驗。

cues.en: Now, here are our two perspectives of the world.
cues.zh: 兩個世界觀點如下。

cues.en: We have the reality whether we program the computer to flash that dim fast light or whether the computer didn't flash anything.
cues.zh: 現實是，程式是否讓電腦閃暗而快的光，還是沒閃。

cues.en: And then we have her perception, which is whether she thinks we flash the light or she doesn't think we flash the light.
cues.zh: 知覺則是，她認為有沒有閃。

cues.en: So the light was actually present or absent.
cues.zh: 實際有光或無光。

cues.en: That's the true state of the world objectively.
cues.zh: 客觀真實狀態。

cues.en: But she thinks she has her own subjective view of the world and she thinks the light wasn't present or it was present.
cues.zh: 她有主觀看法，認為有光或無光。

cues.en: Okay? Now obviously when we did flash the light and she said that we flashed the light, that's a correct response.
cues.zh: 真正有閃，她也說有，就是正確反應。

cues.en: So that would be called a hit in the presence of signal detection theory.
cues.zh: 訊號偵測理論稱為命中。

cues.en: Now, the other way to be accurate for her to give an accurate response is when she gives a correct rejection.
cues.zh: 另一種正確反應，是正確拒絕。

cues.en: That's when the light was actually not present and she said, nope, you guys did not flash a light there.
cues.zh: 沒有光，她也說沒有閃。

cues.en: So that would be a correct rejection.
cues.zh: 就是正確拒絕。

cues.en: So two different ways of giving the correct answer.
cues.zh: 兩種正確答案。

cues.en: And I'm sure you see where this is going.
cues.zh: 你一定猜得到下一步。

cues.en: There are also two different ways of giving an incorrect answer.
cues.zh: 也有兩種錯誤答案。

cues.en: So we have a miss.
cues.zh: 漏失。

cues.en: That is where we actually flashed the light.
cues.zh: 實際閃光，

cues.en: But because it was so fast and it was so dim, she just didn't see it.
cues.zh: 但太快、太暗，沒看到。

cues.en: So she missed it, she said no, she said there was no light flashing.
cues.zh: 她漏掉，說沒有閃光。

cues.en: So that's called a miss.
cues.zh: 叫漏失。

cues.en: And then we have this quadrant over here, and that's a false alarm.
cues.zh: 這個象限是誤報。

cues.en: That's when we didn't actually present the light, but she knows that the light is really dim and hard to see.
cues.zh: 沒有呈現光，但她知道很暗、難看見。

cues.en: So sometimes she actually said that we flashed the light even though we didn't.
cues.zh: 有時即使沒閃，也說閃過。

cues.en: So that would be a false alarm.
cues.zh: 這是誤報。

cues.en: So these are, this is called the four categories of responses.
cues.zh: 這些稱為四種反應類別。

cues.en: That's the official term is signal detection theory, the four categories of responses.
cues.zh: 訊號偵測理論正式稱呼，四種反應類別。

cues.en: So we have a hit, correct rejection, miss, and false alarm.
cues.zh: 命中、正確拒絕、漏失與誤報。

cues.en: So I'm using the terms reality and perception and present and absent.
cues.zh: 用現實、知覺，以及有、無這些詞。

cues.en: Sometimes in signal detection theory, you'll also see slightly different terms.
cues.zh: 有時會看到稍不同術語。

cues.en: They can be objective and subjective or no and yes, instead of absent and present.
cues.zh: 客觀、主觀，或用否、是代替無、有。

cues.en: But you know, I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 你應該懂概念。

cues.en: Now, does this table here, this four quadrant table, does this look familiar?
cues.zh: 這個四象限表熟悉嗎？

cues.en: Does this remind you of anything else that we have discussed in the course?
cues.zh: 讓你想到課程其他內容嗎？

cues.en: Well, I hope so, I hope it reminds you of this table about statistical decisions when the reality about the null hypothesis, which we don't actually know is
cues.zh: 希望想到統計決策的表，虛無假設的現實狀態，其實我們不知道，

cues.en: so the null hypothesis really is true or it really is false.
cues.zh: 究竟真或假。

cues.en: That's not something we can know in theory and we have to make a decision as statisticians, as data analysts to reject the null hypothesis
cues.zh: 理論上無法知道，但統計學家、資料分析師要決定拒絕，

cues.en: or not reject the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 或不拒絕虛無假設。

cues.en: And then there's two ways of making correct responses and two ways of making errors.
cues.zh: 兩種正確反應、兩種錯誤。

cues.en: So I just wanna point out that there's a very deep connection between signal detection theory and statistical decision making.
cues.zh: 所以訊號偵測理論與統計決策，有很深的連結。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video I introduced you to the main idea underlying signal detection theory.
cues.zh: 這支介紹背後主要概念。

cues.en: You can see it's really simple, I explained the whole thing basically just in one slide.
cues.zh: 很簡單，一張投影片基本上就說完。

cues.en: But you'll see over the next several videos that we can develop a pretty rich theory of responses and biases and accuracy and discrimination purely based on looking at
cues.zh: 但接下來會看到，只憑這個簡單二乘二表、

cues.en: that simple two by two table, which contains the four categories of responses.
cues.zh: 四種反應類別，就能發展豐富的反應、偏誤、準確性與辨識理論。

cues.en: So that was hits, correct rejections, misses, and false alarms.
cues.zh: 也就是命中、正確拒絕、漏失與誤報。
